title: Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**
 As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across :500 branches in the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS clients having an AUM \=\> INR 1 million through “need\-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross\-sell and up\-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage \& maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro\-active client engagement \& relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team


**Key Accountabilities**
* Acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch location areas to Treasures segment.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly \& annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e\-Channels (I\-Banking / M\-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation \& execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new\- to\- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on\-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.


**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM \=\> INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products \& services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health \& Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on\-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.
* In\-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage


**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate(10\+2\+3\).


**Location:**
 Tirupur
   

  

**Job:**
 Relationship Management
   

  

**Schedule:**
 Regular
   

  

**Employee Status:**
 Full time

title: Business Development Intern
description:
📢
 **WE’RE HIRING: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT INTERN – GROWTH \& E\-COMMERCE** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢
 **Company:** 
 Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 🏭
 **Industry:** 
 Apparel \| E\-commerce \| Manufacturing \| Retail
 



 🎓
 **Freshers / Final\-Year Students / Recent Graduates Welcome** 




 🚀
 **Full\-Time Opportunity Based on Performance** 




 We are looking for a smart, curious and proactive
 **Business Development Intern** 
 who wants practical exposure to how a growing apparel and e\-commerce business identifies new opportunities, builds partnerships and expands into new sales channels.
 



 This is a hands\-on internship where you will work closely with management on
 **business research, lead generation, market expansion, e\-commerce opportunities and AI\-enabled business development** 
 .
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**1\. Business Development \& Lead Generation** 




 • Research and identify new business opportunities
 



 • Find potential customers, retailers, distributors, resellers and business partners
 



 • Generate and maintain lists of qualified leads
 



 • Reach out through calls, email, LinkedIn and other channels
 



 • Conduct initial discussions with prospects
 



 • Follow up on leads and business enquiries
 



 • Coordinate meetings with management
 



 • Maintain lead and follow\-up trackers
 



 • Assist in converting opportunities into actual business
 



**2\. New Market \& Channel Research** 




 • Research new markets and customer segments
 



 • Identify new marketplaces and online sales channels
 



 • Explore B2B, wholesale, institutional and retail opportunities
 



 • Research distributors and retailers across different cities
 



 • Identify opportunities for new partnerships
 



 • Study potential expansion into new product categories and markets
 



 • Present useful findings and recommendations to management
 



**3\. E\-commerce \& Marketplace Exposure** 




 You will gain exposure to platforms such as:
 



 • Amazon
 



 • Flipkart
 



 • Myntra
 



 • Meesho
 



 • JioMart
 



 • Shopify / D2C
 



 • Other online marketplaces
 



 The intern may assist with:
 



 • Marketplace research
 



 • Competitor monitoring
 



 • Pricing comparisons
 



 • Product opportunity research
 



 • Sales\-channel analysis
 



 • New marketplace onboarding research
 



 • Promotional and growth opportunities
 



**4\. Competitor \& Market Analysis** 




 • Research competing brands and products
 



 • Compare pricing, offers, product ranges and positioning
 



 • Monitor competitor websites and marketplaces
 



 • Study customer reviews and feedback
 



 • Identify gaps in the market
 



 • Track new trends and business models
 



 • Prepare short competitor and market reports
 



**5\. AI\-ENABLED BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT** 




 We actively encourage the use of modern AI tools.
 



 Candidates familiar with or interested in learning tools such as:
 



 • ChatGPT
 



 • Gemini
 



 • Claude
 



 • AI research tools
 



 • AI presentation tools
 



 • Productivity and automation tools
 



 will have an advantage.
 



 AI can be used for:
 



 • Lead research
 



 • Competitor analysis
 



 • Market research
 



 • Drafting emails and outreach messages
 



 • Preparing presentations
 



 • Business proposals
 



 • Data analysis
 



 • Summarising information
 



 • Creating reports
 



 • Identifying new opportunities
 



 You do not need to be an AI expert.
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **curious about technology and willing to learn how to use AI effectively for real business work** 
 .
 



**6\. Sales \& Business Communication** 




 • Draft professional emails and messages
 



 • Assist with customer and partner communication
 



 • Prepare presentations and basic proposals
 



 • Follow up on quotations and discussions
 



 • Maintain records of conversations and next actions
 



 • Coordinate communication between prospects and management
 



**7\. Data \& Reporting** 




 • Work with Excel / Google Sheets
 



 • Maintain lead databases and business trackers
 



 • Prepare weekly business\-development updates
 



 • Track enquiries, meetings and conversions
 



 • Organise market and competitor information
 



 • Convert research into clear summaries for management
 



**8\. Business Operations Exposure** 




 The intern will also gain exposure to how different parts of the business work together, including:
 



 • E\-commerce
 



 • Production
 



 • Warehouse
 



 • Dispatch
 



 • Marketing
 



 • Administration
 



 • Customer operations
 



 This helps understand how a business opportunity moves from an idea into actual execution.
 


 WHO CAN APPLY?
 
 Students or graduates from:
 



 • BBA / MBA
 



 • B.Com / M.Com
 



 • BE / B.Tech
 



 • BCA / MCA
 



 • Marketing
 



 • E\-commerce
 



 • Business Management
 



 • Fashion / Textile programmes
 



 • Any degree with strong interest in business and technology
 



 Freshers and final\-year students are welcome.
 


 SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 ✅ Strong communication skills
 



 ✅ Good spoken and written English
 



 ✅ Confidence speaking with new people
 



 ✅ Good internet research ability
 



 ✅ Basic Excel / Google Sheets knowledge
 



 ✅ Interest in sales and business growth
 



 ✅ Comfortable using LinkedIn and online tools
 



 ✅ Strong follow\-up ability
 



 ✅ Curious and willing to learn
 



 ✅ Interest in AI and new technology
 



 ✅ Ability to independently research and complete assigned tasks
 



 ✅ Comfortable working directly with management
 


 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 
 We are looking for someone who enjoys:
 



**Research → Identify Opportunity → Find Contact → Approach → Follow Up → Learn → Improve → Convert** 




 The person should not be afraid of communicating with new people or trying new approaches.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who wants to understand
 **how businesses actually find customers and create growth** 
 , rather than only learning theory.
 


 WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
 
 You will gain practical exposure to:
 



 • Business Development
 



 • Lead Generation
 



 • B2B Sales
 



 • E\-commerce
 



 • Marketplace Growth
 



 • Competitor Research
 



 • Customer Research
 



 • AI Tools
 



 • Business Communication
 



 • Sales Tracking
 



 • Business Operations
 



 • Commercial Decision\-Making
 


 CAREER OPPORTUNITY
 
 Strong performers may be considered for full\-time positions such as:
 



 • Business Development Executive

 • E\-commerce Executive
 



 • Business Operations Executive

title: Brand Manager
description:
📢
 **WE’RE HIRING: BRAND MANAGER – D2C \& E\-COMMERCE** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢
 **Brand:** 
 ROBINBOSKY
 



 🏭
 **Industry:** 
 Apparel \| Fashion \| D2C \| E\-commerce
 



 💰
 **Salary:** 
 ₹18,000\- ₹30,000 per month
 



 🧑‍💼
 **Experience:** 
 2–7 Years
 



 ROBINBOSKY is looking for a
 **hands\-on Brand Manager** 
 to take ownership of how our brand is presented, communicated and grown across our website, marketplaces, advertising and social channels.
 



 We sell apparel through our own D2C website and major e\-commerce marketplaces including
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and others** 
 .
 



 This role is for someone who can bring together:
 



**Product → Brand → Creative → Content → Marketing → E\-commerce → Customer → Growth** 




 This is
 **not just a social\-media posting role** 
 .
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning** 




 • Develop and maintain a clear positioning for ROBINBOSKY
 



 • Ensure consistent brand communication across every customer touchpoint
 



 • Understand our target customers and translate customer insights into better marketing
 



 • Develop messaging for products, collections, campaigns and promotions
 



 • Ensure our products are presented consistently across website, marketplaces and advertising
 



 • Monitor competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate the brand
 



 • Help management develop the long\-term direction of ROBINBOSKY
 



**2\. Creative \& Content Management** 




 • Plan creative requirements for products and marketing campaigns
 



 • Work closely with graphic designers, photographers, video editors and AI creative tools
 



 • Develop briefs for product images, lifestyle images, banners, reels and advertisements
 



 • Review creatives before publishing
 



 • Ensure designs follow brand standards
 



 • Maintain consistency in fonts, visual style, messaging and product presentation
 



 • Plan content around products, occasions, seasons and campaigns
 



 The Brand Manager does not necessarily need to personally design everything.
 



 The responsibility is to make sure the
 **right creative gets produced in the right format for the right purpose** 
 .
 



**3\. D2C Website \& Shopify** 




 • Work closely with the e\-commerce team on ROBINBOSKY's Shopify store
 



 • Review product pages, collections, banners and merchandising
 



 • Improve product presentation and customer experience
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates
 



 • Monitor customer behaviour and identify areas where shoppers drop off
 



 • Plan offers, bundles and merchandising strategies
 



 • Coordinate new product and collection launches
 



 • Ensure website communication matches advertising campaigns
 



**4\. Marketplace Brand Management** 




 Coordinate brand presentation across:
 



 • Amazon
 



 • Flipkart
 



 • Myntra
 



 • Meesho
 



 • JioMart
 



 • Other relevant marketplaces
 



 Responsibilities include:
 



 • Product presentation
 



 • Images and listing content
 



 • Brand\-store presentation
 



 • Enhanced / premium content where applicable
 



 • Campaign communication
 



 • Product launches
 



 • Pricing and promotional coordination
 



 • Competitor monitoring
 



**5\. Digital Marketing Coordination** 




 Work with internal teams and external specialists managing:
 



 • Google Ads
 



 • Meta Ads
 



 • Marketplace advertising
 



 • Influencer marketing
 



 • Social media
 



 • Remarketing
 



 • Email / WhatsApp marketing
 



 The Brand Manager should understand advertising performance well enough to determine:
 



**What are we advertising?** 




**Who are we targeting?** 




**What creative are they seeing?** 




**What message are we communicating?** 




**Where are we sending the customer?** 




**And is it actually producing business?** 




 The candidate does not need to personally manage every advertising campaign.
 



 However, they should be able to work effectively with performance\-marketing specialists and make better brand and creative decisions using advertising data.
 



**6\. Product \& Collection Marketing** 




 • Understand ROBINBOSKY's product categories, colours, fits and customer segments
 



 • Develop product positioning and key selling points
 



 • Plan new product launches
 



 • Coordinate product photography and creative requirements
 



 • Develop campaign concepts around individual products or collections
 



 • Analyse which products, colours and styles customers respond to
 



 • Recommend opportunities for new products, bundles and collections
 



**7\. Social Media \& Community** 




 • Develop content direction for Instagram and other relevant platforms
 



 • Plan monthly content calendars
 



 • Coordinate reels, posts, stories and campaigns
 



 • Develop content around products without making every post feel like an advertisement
 



 • Monitor customer comments, feedback and trends
 



 • Identify influencer and creator opportunities
 



 • Maintain consistent brand voice
 



**8\. Customer \& Competitor Research** 




 • Regularly analyse customer reviews and feedback
 



 • Study customer questions, objections and buying behaviour
 



 • Monitor competing apparel brands
 



 • Analyse their products, pricing, promotions, creatives and positioning
 



 • Identify emerging fashion and e\-commerce trends
 



 • Convert research into practical recommendations
 



**9\. AI\-ENABLED BRAND MANAGEMENT** 




 We actively encourage the use of modern AI tools.
 



 Candidates comfortable with tools such as:
 



 • ChatGPT
 



 • Claude
 



 • Gemini
 



 • AI image and video tools
 



 • AI research tools
 



 • Analytics tools
 



 • Automation platforms
 



 will have an advantage.
 



 AI can be used for:
 



 • Consumer research
 



 • Competitor analysis
 



 • Campaign ideation
 



 • Creative briefs
 



 • Copywriting
 



 • Advertisement concepts
 



 • Product positioning
 



 • Data analysis
 



 • Content planning
 



 • Research and reporting
 



 • Workflow automation
 



 We are particularly interested in someone who experiments with
 **new tools and better ways of working** 
 , rather than relying only on traditional methods.
 



**10\. Data \& Performance** 




 The Brand Manager should monitor numbers, not only creatives.
 



 Track areas such as:
 



 • Website traffic
 



 • Conversion rate
 



 • Average order value
 



 • Customer acquisition cost
 



 • Advertising performance
 



 • Product\-level sales
 



 • Marketplace performance
 



 • Creative performance
 



 • Returning customers
 



 • Social engagement
 



 • Customer reviews and feedback
 



 Use this information to continuously improve brand decisions.
 


 INTERNAL COORDINATION
 
 You will work closely with:
 



 • Management
 



 • E\-commerce Operations
 



 • Graphic Designers
 



 • Content / Video Team
 



 • Performance Marketing Team
 



 • Production
 



 • Warehouse \& Dispatch
 



 • Customer Support
 



 • External agencies / freelancers when required
 



 The role requires strong
 **coordination and follow\-up ability** 
 , not only creative thinking.
 


 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 ✅
 **2–7 years of relevant experience** 




 Preferred backgrounds include:
 



 • D2C brands
 



 • Fashion / Apparel
 



 • E\-commerce
 



 • Brand Management
 



 • Digital Marketing
 



 • Consumer brands
 



 • Marketing agencies handling D2C clients
 



 The candidate should have:
 



 • Strong understanding of branding and marketing
 



 • Good visual judgement
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication
 



 • Understanding of digital advertising
 



 • Understanding of e\-commerce
 



 • Good analytical ability
 



 • Experience working with designers and creative teams
 



 • Ability to use data for decision\-making
 



 • Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
 



 • Comfortable working directly with management
 



 • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
 



 • Curiosity about AI and new technology
 



 Experience with
 **Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Google Ads or Meta Ads** 
 will be an advantage.
 


 IDEAL PERSON FOR THIS ROLE
 
 We are looking for someone who thinks beyond:
 



**“What should we post on Instagram today?”** 




 and instead asks:
 



**Who is our customer? → What do they want? → Which product should we promote? → What should we communicate? → What creative should we make? → Where should we advertise it? → What happened after launch? → What should we improve next?** 




 The person should have a combination of:
 



 🎨
 **Creative thinking** 




 📊
 **Data\-driven decision making** 




 🛒
 **E\-commerce understanding** 




 📣
 **Marketing knowledge** 




 🤖
 **AI awareness** 




 🎯
 **Strong execution and follow\-up** 



 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 
 Performance will be evaluated based on:
 



 • Brand consistency across channels
 



 • Quality and effectiveness of creatives
 



 • Website and marketplace presentation
 



 • Campaign execution
 



 • Product launch execution
 



 • Improvement in customer engagement
 



 • Advertising creative performance
 



 • E\-commerce growth
 



 • Customer insights generated
 



 • Speed of creative execution
 



 • Successful coordination between teams
 



 • New ideas and experiments implemented
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 💰
 **₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 




 Final compensation will depend on:
 



 • Relevant brand experience
 



 • D2C / e\-commerce exposure
 



 • Apparel / fashion experience
 



 • Creative judgement
 



 • Digital\-marketing knowledge
 



 • Analytical ability
 



 • AI\-tool exposure
 



 • Ability to independently take ownership
 



 📩
 **TO APPLY** 




 Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume.
 



 Please mention:
 



 • Current Salary
 



 • Expected Salary
 



 • Notice Period
 



 • Current Location
 



 • Brands previously worked with
 



 • E\-commerce / D2C experience
 



 • Digital\-marketing experience
 



 • AI tools you currently use
 



 If available, please also share a
 **portfolio, campaigns, social pages, websites or brands you have previously worked on.**
